title: Haldi + Tiger Balm Knee Compress (Avoid Knee Replacement Surgery)
urdu: اصلی ہلدی کو ٹائیگر بالم کے ساتھ مکس کر کے ۵ دن گوڈوں پر باندھیں، گوڈے تبدیل کروانے کی ضرورت نہیں پڑے گی۔

englishDescription: Mix pure unadulterated turmeric with Tiger Balm. In winter, wrap securely around painful knees with a cloth bandage continuously for 5 days. In summer, apply at night and wash in the morning. This deep compress repairs cartilage, saves knees, and avoids knee replacement surgery.
